scope: Static read-only audit of package_final.py against actual qualification, freeze/guard, post, retention producers and review receipts. No packager or producer function was executed; no GO or runtime qualification is inferred.

findings.location: verify_post, LEAK scan and isolated rerun loop
findings.issue: The rerun receipt is not bound to the actual leaked test cases.
findings.evidence: If any LEAK line exists, the draft requires a nonempty isolated-leak-reruns receipt and validates each supplied row. It never derives the expected phase/test identity set from leak_lines or compares that set/count with rerun rows. One unrelated clean row can therefore satisfy multiple unrerun leaks. Current all-Core log contains a LEAK for retained_copy_ownership_depends_on_authored_nodes_not_visible_matching_plays.
findings.action: Require exact coverage of the leaked phase/test or executed-binary/test identities, reject duplicate and unrelated rerun rows, and verify each row's available binary/source evidence. Retain original LEAK lines and isolated results.

findings.location: verify_source_guards and verify_all source-review basis checks
findings.issue: The original fourteen reviewed overlay file hashes are not bound to the final candidate map.
findings.evidence: source-review-basis.json records prototype_final_map_sha256=0677019b918263bf58ca4f411e2fa098aa0ca5eef98bba37d5215093f2bbfe0d, but the draft never reads or checks that map. Exact seventeen-path delta membership plus agreement among current phase maps admits arbitrary new hashes inside the original fourteen paths while still citing the unchanged earlier reviews. Direct final review-hash binding exists for the two positive-test files and the separate Store call correction only.
findings.action: Load and hash-check the exact reviewed final prototype map, derive the original fourteen-path overlay, and compare those fourteen hashes with final candidate identities. Compare only the reviewed overlay paths, since the later positive test and Store-call changes legitimately differ from the earlier complete map.

findings.issue: An empty or incomplete timing metric extraction can pass the timing gate vacuously.
findings.evidence: metric_names is taken from trials[0].metrics. Empty metrics on every trial and empty per-kind summaries satisfy all set comparisons and execute no recomputation checks. The actual app producer emits large_first_pause_input_to_commit_ms and large_first_pause_input_to_offscreen_background_composition_ms (large_first_pause.rs199/204); post.py only filters names by prefix.
findings.action: Require the expected nonempty metric names and finite numeric values for all ten rows before recomputing summaries. Refuse missing, renamed, NaN or infinite measurements.

findings.issue: One-leaf verifier reports are not required to declare overall success.
findings.evidence: The branch checks selected picture/audio fields but never checks verification.passed is true and verification.failures is empty. Neutral/aligned receipts do check their overall success. Normal test-produced output is sound because the test asserts passed, but the packager can accept an explicitly failed or newly extended verifier result when the selected fields remain acceptable.
findings.action: Require passed=true and failures=[] for each cached/uncached full verification report before accepting its selected metric checks.

resolved_during_review.issue: The actual retention producer appended literal backslash+n bytes after two one-leaf JSON values.
resolved_during_review.effect_if_unfixed: The portable-package-checksums JSON would fail the packager's json.loads call with trailing non-whitespace; the retained one-leaf summary would also be invalid JSON.
resolved_during_review.resolution: Root preserved the pre-execution producer and changed both source literals to newline bytes before the producer's first execution. Static re-read confirms normal newline literals. Root's receipt explicitly records post_commands_executed=0, retention_has_not_run=true and actual_runtime_failure=false.

checks_without_findings: Seventeen exact changed paths, 2053 Rust paths and six inputs match the currently declared source scope; strict phase uses inputs.json while freeze.py phases use lock.json.
Twenty-six post command names/order match post.py: one portable, five native and ten alternating fixture-make/run pairs.
Test binary and helper manifest shapes match qualify_all_ui.py and qualify_native_media.py; retained executed copies are checked instead of later-overwritten shared target outputs.
Final changed-source snapshots use release-native-source; literal old positive review c90e is kept historical while final two-file refactor hashes are separately checked.
Raw capture excludes extracted builds, full source directories, build/source archives, executable copies and generated project roots.

Already compressed gz files bypass text compression, avoiding gzip double wrapping. Explicit emitted-media capture retains both one-leaf MP4s and portable tarballs and includes them in the final inventory.
Internal tuple-key timing maps are not serialized; returned gate summaries use JSON-compatible string-keyed dictionaries.
Missing future phase, media, post, timing or GO receipts refuse before publication. This static review does not establish those pending outcomes.
limitations: No packager, producer, parser, compiler, native runtime, browser or Git operation was executed by reviewer.
Root owns draft changes, rerun receipt schema, full qualification, final GO and eventual package execution.
This report applies to the exact draft hash above; corrected draft needs delta review.
